P-001.title: Customer change and arrangement confirmation
P-001.description: After customer feedback, a designer assesses scope. A lead confirms additional commitments and returned requests continue in the same record.
system_responsibilities: Save original evidence, decisions and delivery results; distinguish their failures.
key_features: Retain original input, make explicit decisions and recover from exceptions.

exception_handling.handling: Retain the decision and show failed delivery with a reviewed retry.

P-002.title: Notification failure review
P-002.description: Deliver after a saved decision. On failure retain that decision and ask the lead to review before explicitly retrying the same delivery.
system_responsibilities: Save original evidence, decisions and delivery results; distinguish their failures.
key_features: Retain original input, make explicit decisions and recover from exceptions.

exception_handling.handling: Retain the decision and show failed delivery with a reviewed retry.
